metadata.title: Dry Fish with Bitter Gourd | Kankelong Nakham | Garo Recipe
metadata.description:
Kankelong Nakham or  Dry Fish with Bitter Gourd is a simple dish made in Garo household. It is a simple boil of bitter gourd and dry fish along with lye obtained from the ashes of banana stem.

Enjoy this simple recipe with a bowl of steamed rice.
